:::{#exm-universal-quantifier}
#### A universally quantified proposition

Let $P(x)$ be the predicate "$x$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd)".

- "$\forall x \in \cb{2, 4, 6}, P(x)$" is true,
  because $2$, $4$, and $6$ are all even.
- "$\forall x \in \cb{2, 3, 4}, P(x)$" is false, because $P(3)$ is false.

:::
